:::note[Generated]
The `apply` tool as the server lists it in `tools/list`. Generated from turf-mcp-server v1.3.0-8-ga90b39e595 by `scripts/generate-reference.mjs`: change the server, then run `npm run generate`.

Approve the plan a convergence waits on, named by its digest, and apply it — `tofu apply` of the vended plan. Calling this IS the approval. Applies the round, then stops at the next round's plan gate (awaiting_plan; call plan) when a change was deferred, or ends the convergence: converged, stalled, exhausted, stale, failed or cancelled. decline declines the plan instead: nothing of it is applied and the convergence ends declined (reason says why). Turf actions the apply triggers stop it too (awaiting_actions, with action_requests): steps the configuration asks you to carry out — a check, a notification, a question for the user. Perform them, then call apply with action_results, one result per key, all at once; that call follows the apply on. A plan_digest approves only the plan it names: one naming another plan this server vended is refused, and after a takeover (a server restart, a convergence `open` reported) the plan the engine holds is vended anew with a note instead — nothing is applied either way. With no digest, no decline and no results, nothing is answered: a convergence waiting at a gate is handed back as it stands (its plan vended again at an approval point), and one planning or applying is followed. Names the convergence by convergence_id, or by the workspace it holds (workspace_alias). With planfile (and plan_digest, its digest): applies a planfile a plan_only run left — a new one-round convergence on the workspace, which must be free — ending converged, exhausted, or stale (the digest is not the plan's, or the configuration, the state or the workspace moved since the plan; the planfile stays). A planfile that expired or was applied already is refused by name. Returns applying at the server's deadline (ended false): the convergence goes on in the engine; call apply again to follow it. The same holds if the call ends early (cancelled, or the client went away); cancel stops it.

**[Tiers](/docs/reference/server/#tiers):** apply · full

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `convergence_id` | string | no | The convergence_id from the result that vended the plan, or that listed the turf actions. To approve a plan, or to take a convergence up, it may be omitted for the workspace it holds (workspace_alias); decline and action_results need it. |
| `workspace_alias` | string | no | Without convergence_id: the workspace whose convergence to continue — its alias as 'open' named it, omitted for the workspace opened without an alias ('default'). |
| `plan_digest` | string | no | plan.digest from the result that vended the plan: the plan you are approving. The digest of any other plan is refused. Omit it, decline and action_results to take up a convergence without answering anything ('open' reported it, or a call ended early): the gate it waits at is handed back, nothing approved. |
| `decline` | boolean | no | At awaiting_approval: decline the plan instead of approving it. Nothing of it is applied, and the convergence ends declined. Names the convergence by convergence_id; never with plan_digest or action_results. |
| `reason` | string | no | With decline: why, recorded on the round. |
| `action_results` | map of object | no | At awaiting_actions: your result for each of action_requests, by its key — every one at once, to the convergence_id that listed them. A result that is refused is named under refused in the result, and its request stays open. |
| `action_results.<key>.succeeded` | boolean | yes | Whether the step did what the prompt asked. false fails the action, and on_failure decides what that does; it needs at least one error diagnostic saying why. |
| `action_results.<key>.progress` | array of string | no | What was done, a line each, in order — the commands run, what each showed, the user's own words. Recorded as the action's progress. |
| `action_results.<key>.diagnostics` | array of object | no | Problems found: an error for each reason the step failed (only when succeeded is false), a warning for anything worth knowing that did not fail it. |
| `action_results.<key>.diagnostics[].severity` | string | yes | error or warning. |
| `action_results.<key>.diagnostics[].summary` | string | yes | One line. |
| `action_results.<key>.diagnostics[].detail` | string | no | The specifics: what was observed, what was expected. |
| `planfile` | string | no | A planfile to apply on the workspace (workspace_alias): planfile.ref from the planned result of a plan_only run (status lists the planfiles a workspace holds). With plan_digest, the planfile's digest as you read it (planfile.digest; show with planfile reads the document) — the approval, of exactly that plan; with any other digest the convergence ends stale and nothing is applied. Starts a new one-round convergence that applies the plan as it was made: stale too when the configuration, the state or the workspace moved since (the planfile stays for another try). A planfile that expired or was applied already is refused by name. The workspace must be free. Never with convergence_id, decline, reason or action_results. |
